source.inspectionScope: Fresh full62-line2-file dialog layout patch read. All three wrapping label hooks,55ch min width and actual shared wrap rule checked in fixed source. No native dialog, locale, zoom or font matrix execution; linked toolkit discussion not independently read.

commit ca10cb3d23d224611dca68a17b0c6cd90b128b53
Author:     Richard Marti <richard.marti@gmail.com>
AuthorDate: Thu Apr 24 16:23:52 2025 +0000
Commit:     Richard Marti <richard.marti@gmail.com>
CommitDate: Thu Apr 24 16:23:52 2025 +0000

    Bug 1960861 - Give the Return Receipt dialog a min width. r=aleca
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D246083

diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/receipts.xhtml b/mail/components/preferences/receipts.xhtml
index d37d5e84b77..74282cdc6de 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/receipts.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/receipts.xhtml
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
   <html:body
     xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul"
   >
-    <dialog id="ReturnReceiptsDialog">
+    <dialog id="ReturnReceiptsDialog" style="min-width: 55ch">
       <vbox id="returnReceiptSettings" align="start">
         <checkbox
           id="alwaysRequest"
@@ -76,6 +76,7 @@
             <hbox flex="1">
               <label
                 id="notInToCcLabel"
+                class="wrap"
                 data-l10n-id="receipt-not-to-cc-label"
                 control="notInToCcPref"
               />
@@ -95,6 +96,7 @@
             <hbox flex="1">
               <label
                 id="outsideDomainLabel"
+                class="wrap"
                 data-l10n-id="sender-outside-domain-label"
                 control="outsideDomainPref"
               />
@@ -114,6 +116,7 @@
             <hbox flex="1">
               <label
                 id="otherCasesLabel"
+                class="wrap"
                 data-l10n-id="other-cases-text-label"
                 control="otherCasesPref"
               />
diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/dialog.css b/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/dialog.css
index 97e0d2bb0da..63b4f424d08 100644
--- a/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/dialog.css
+++ b/mail/themes/shared/mail/preferences/dialog.css
@@ -112,6 +112,10 @@ textbox.tree-input {
   margin-inline-start: 8px;
 }
 
+.wrap {
+  white-space: wrap;
+}
+
 #siteCol {
   flex: 3 auto;
 }
